note: It never colours a change good or bad, and it says it cannot show that a supplement works.
post: The supplement before and after view in Intus stays quiet until you have logged 10 days in each period. It never colours a change good or bad, and it says plainly that it cannot show a supplement works.

headline: Every set is saved on your device first.
sub: A closed tab or a lost connection never loses a set. Anything not sent yet says so.
post: Every strength set is saved on your device first and then sent. A closed tab or a lost connection never loses a set, and anything not sent yet is marked "not sent yet".
alt: A card that reads: Every set is saved on your device first. A closed tab or a lost connection never loses a set. Anything not sent yet says so.
